verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's architecture is explicitly API-first: all configuration is done via a RESTful Admin API or declarative config (decK), with Kong Manager UI acting as a client on top of the same API (kong-gh-5, kong-gh-10, kong-gh-11). Konnect additionally exposes a dedicated MCP server for AI-agent access to the platform, confirmed live via handshake probe, extending programmatic parity to AI-native clients (kong-docs-3, kong-probe-2, kong-probe-5).
